image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey Siam Commercial Bank branch building, detailed front elevation with a glazed frontage and glass entrance door under a deep purple fascia carrying the SCB wordmark and bo-leaf roundel device on a backlit sign, a recessed bay of two ATM machines in a purple surround set into the front wall, polished stone plinth below the glazing, plain warm cream painted side and rear walls in a single flat off-white tone clearly lighter than the background, with a secure service door and barred high windows, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: purple painted composite panel brushed stainless ATM fascia and polished stone at the front, tinted plate glass, flat warm cream painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless MID-DARK neutral grey (#606060), distinctly darker than every part of the building so the object reads as a clean cut-out against it. The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: SCB / Siam Commercial Bank. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.92, up from 0.87. 3076/16000 triangles, 11/12 draw calls, 8/12 materials, 11/16 unique geometries. Draw calls remain the binding axis. The brief's item is on the model: plain tinted glass with no interior image. Residuals: the purple renders a shade darker than the plate, the plinth a shade lighter, the four units share one geometry where the plate has three shapes, and the plate's lit interior is by rule not shown.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m (coping 2 cm proud on each face: 8.04 x 7.02); Meshy's independent reconstruction agrees on height to 0.6% and depth to 4.5%. The coping ring is ONE level all the way round (rectified side y 4.30..4.60) and the four rooftop units stand above it to 4.965 -- an 8% overrun on one axis inside the 10% tolerance, on plant, with walls, parapet and coping at exactly 4.60.
featureReviews.notes: Fourth build. The third build's side upstands stopped 0.65 m below the front parapet and its plant sat in a metre-deep well; both silhouette events now read as the plate's. Residual: four identical instanced units where the plate shows five of three shapes.

featureReviews.evidence: White SCB beside the gold bo-leaf outline on purple #381F62 (PBR confidence 0.860), on a panel proud of the band it sits in. BAKED from Nano Banana 2 edits of the plate's sign crop, laid out at the plate's ratios in a 2048 x 1024 atlas shared with the kiosk faces. Unchanged from the third build.
featureReviews.notes: The band renders #2e1c5e at the hero angle against the plate's clean-panel #391f63 -- a shade darker under the harness, which is the residual here; the mark itself is the real leaf.

featureReviews.evidence: Purple cladding #381F62 carrying the band, the entrance portal and the ATM surround carved into two 0.58 x 2.18 m niches 0.25 m deep with a stainless kiosk in each whose CURVED front carries the kiosk-face image from the plate's own ATM crop, and a dark trim on each reveal. The glass wall is continuous from 0.45 m in from the corner to the surround, light-framed, with the transom rail at 2.21 m and glass above the door header.
featureReviews.notes: With the interior image gone the portal and the framing now sit on a pane that does not slide against them as the camera orbits; the arrangement is the plate's.

featureReviews.evidence: Plain tinted plate glass #4b5c60 at opacity 0.90 / roughness 0.12, NO interior image (on the brief), over a dark backdrop slab (vertex tone 0x484848) folded into the roof-deck submission. Rendered at azimuth 0 the pane measures #35474b, luma 66, against the plate pane's #3e4243, luma 66; saturation 0.29 rendered holds it out of the silhouette gate (threshold 0.16) and the turntable gate runs without --allow-holes.
featureReviews.notes: The third build's projected interior read as a photograph stuck to the pane. The pane now reads as dark glass over a dim room, the door leaves a shade darker still as a second layer. Residual: the plate's pane shows a lit hall behind it, which an exterior shell does not carry.

featureReviews.evidence: Two-step cast-stone plinth (#A7A196, PBR confidence 0.854) projecting forward at the base to the declared envelope face, under a terrazzo speckle tile (5000 specks, patchAmp 30).
featureReviews.notes: Renders luma 170 on the front face against a plate face reading of 128: the harness lights a +Z face harder than the plate's studio does.

featureReviews.evidence: +X elevation homography-rectified off the plate: hooded double service door at z 0.03..1.45, y 0.09..2.56 (two leaves, dark reveal and meeting gap, lever handle) and two hooded barred windows BEHIND it at z -1.45..-0.52 and -2.90..-2.03, y 2.35..3.15 (light frame, four vertical and one horizontal dark bar, dark pane) -- across three existing components, no new draw call.
featureReviews.notes: The third build had the windows in FRONT of the door and the door a metre too far back, as flat slabs. Not mirrored onto the unobserved -X wall.

featureReviews.evidence: Four louvred packaged units (casing, flanged lid, top cowl and fan disc, round front fan guard with five light bars, nine-blade louvre end, panel seams, feet) as ONE instanced geometry with per-part vertex tones on the deck material, under the galvanised spangle tile baked for the Flash Express plant. Deck at 4.09..4.21 inside a 0.94 m ring with a 2 cm proud coping.
featureReviews.notes: Rendered casing luma 131 against the plate's 144. Residual: the plate's five units are of three shapes, one with a duct elbow; all four here share one geometry.
